### New in 1.5.2
- **Movable Shelf Stickers**: Stickers are now fully draggable! Touch and drag any sticker to slide and reposition it anywhere across the shelf with smooth tactile haptic physics and elevation drop-shadows.
- **Double-Tap Home / Library Navigation**: Streamlined bottom navigation so the first page only shows the "Home" button. Double-tap the Home button to seamlessly transform it into the "Library" button and navigate to the Library screen, and double-tap again to switch back to Home.
- **Reading-Only Bookmarks**: Bookmarks on book covers now appear exclusively for books currently being read ("Reading"), keeping finished book covers clean and unadorned.

### Install / update
Download `shelfwise.apk` below and open it. It installs over older versions and keeps everything.
